variables.name: GENERIC_ESP_OVERHEAD_MAX_V4
variables.comment:
* Max ESP overhead possible * *

60 (Outer IPv4 + options) + 8 (UDP encap) + 4 (SPI) + 4 (Seq) + 2 (Pad Length + Next * Header). Note: Payload data, Pad Length and Next Header will need to be padded to be multiple * of the block size of a cipher, and at the same time be aligned on a 4-byte boundary.

variables.name: GENERIC_ESP_OVERHEAD_MAX_V6
variables.comment:
* Max ESP overhead possible * *

40 (Outer IPv6) + 4 (SPI) + 4 (Seq) + 2 (Pad Length + Next Header). Note: Payload data, * Pad Length and Next Header will need to be padded to be multiple of the block size of a * cipher, and at the same time be aligned on a 4-byte boundary.

methods.name: public static int getMtu(@NonNull List<ChildSaProposal> childProposals, int maxMtu, int underlyingMtu, boolean isIpv4)
methods.comment:
* Calculates the MTU of the inner interface based on the parameters provided * *

The MTU of the inner interface will be the minimum of the following: * *

    *
  • The MTU of the outer interface, minus the greatest ESP overhead (based on proposed * algorithms). *
  • The maximum MTU as provided in the arguments. *
